description: Admin only. The raw file is the request body (streamed, not buffered), at most 2 GiB. The file name comes from the name query parameter when it is a valid backup name, else one is made from the backup. Errors carry a backup.error.<code> message id: invalid-types, weak-passphrase, wrong-passphrase, not-a-backup (404), invalid-archive, newer-format, too-large (413), busy (409), token-expired (410), name-taken, restore-failed.
